name: SemiFive Inc.
summary: SemiFive Inc. provides silicon solutions and system-on-chip (SoC) design services. The company offers SoC platforms, including AI Inference, AIoT, and HPC platforms; idea hand-off ASIC design, which manages the entire process from concept to manufacturing; design and engineering services for front-end and back-end design projects; and turnkey manufacturing services that include wafer fabrication, packaging, testing, and supply chain management. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
